goal: Produce the durable #2478 live-proof artifact through a narrowly scoped verified-TLS read-only production probe without widening helper grants or weakening the general proof route
prohibited_actions: do not alter any database schema, helper EXECUTE privilege, application row, or migration
do not disable TLS certificate or hostname verification
do not weaken the general Management API proof route or BYPASSRLS refusal
do not dispatch a production migration workflow
required_checks: read-only exact #2478 probe returns one passed=true row through the verified session pooler
assumptions: the repository Actions secret SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD_PRODUCTION exists
Supabase Root 2021 CA remains valid and verifies the session pooler hostname
the immutable #2478 probe bytes match the pinned digest
stop_conditions: stop if the issue #2478 probe, production target, or CA bytes differ from their reviewed pins
stop if the required proof needs a database write or grant change
stop if the change needs a file outside allowed_paths
